correctness.rationale: Differentiating relative entropy and expanding the three-way tensor gives Vdot=-2D*alpha Q exactly. Rank g-1 and positive kernel ensure Q vanishes only at the interior coexistence point; on compact entropy sublevels Q/V is bounded above and below by positive constants. Integration establishes the exact iff, and bounded logarithmic derivatives establish the offspring Cesaro mean. Planar entropy level geometry proves the periodic pure-pairwise orbit statement. A 1200-case reproducible exact rational checker independently cross-checks nonstandard finite algebra, not infinite-time dynamics.

value.rationale: The fixed alpha stabilization observation left unresolved how transient or decaying three-way contest interventions influence asymptotic coexistence when species demographic clocks differ. An iff based only on cumulative contest exposure sharply separates α(t)=(1+t)^-1 from α(t)=(1+t)^-2, with an exact remaining entropy budget. The universal offspring Cesaro average shows long-term balance persists even where pointwise coexistence fails. This is a motivated qualitative distinction for the specific ecological mechanism, not a routine parameter normalization.
